artist_notes.name: Underworld
artist_notes.note: Romford-born electronic institution behind Born Slippy and Dark & Long; a rave-canon live act.

artist_notes.name: FCUKERS
artist_notes.note: NYC electro/house duo with a loud, sweaty live-meets-DJ sound.

artist_notes.name: Nia Archives
artist_notes.note: UK jungle and drum and bass producer who brought the sound back into the mainstream.

curator_note: Underworld live at golden hour is the real draw, and Nia Archives's jungle set plus FCUKERS makes the undercard better than most festivals manage. Moby is the nostalgic wildcard; the Rose Bowl lawn is a trek, but this bill earns it.
description: Afternoon-into-night open-air bill at the Rose Bowl's Brookside with Moby, Underworld, FCUKERS, Nia Archives and DJ Holographic.

curator_note: A cheap Thursday-night DTLA deep and minimal session with a secret location, so it is more a roll-the-dice local night than a destination. Fine if you want a late low-commitment dance, but I don't know the names.
description: Recollect Underground's late-night deep house and minimal session in DTLA, location announced via Instagram, from 11PM.

artist_notes.name: SEEPS
artist_notes.note: On the bill; a pick from the listener's own rotation signals.

curator_note: Disco-leaning house running 10pm to 6am from the Better Tomorrow crew is the right shape for a proper Saturday-night session. The venue is still TBA, so keep an eye out for the drop; SEEPS is the reason it ranks.
description: Better Tomorrow's Dialed In, a 10pm-6am disco and house night with a TBA location.

curator_note: A free-with-RSVP Thursday afters at the Lexington, close to home, with no lineup posted. A low-stakes tech-house and minimal option if you are already out in DTLA, but there is little to go on.
description: Blind Tiger's 11pm-5am after-hours tech-house and minimal night at The Lexington in DTLA.

curator_note: Dialogue's deep and funky house runs 11:59pm to 7am the night after Thanksgiving, which is a good time to dance it off. Venue is TBA and I can't vouch for the names, but the format is right.
description: Dialogue's overnight deep and funky house party in DTLA, 11:59pm to 7am, venue TBA.

curator_note: A Zebulon night built around three of the best 80s UK bands, so expect a dance-floor sing-along rather than a concert. Good for the Cure and Smiths heads on the eastside, but it is a theme night, not a discovery.
description: Theme night at Zebulon in Frogtown devoted to the music of The Cure, The Smiths and Depeche Mode.

curator_note: A cheap Friday-night Halloween-season warehouse thing with a secret location and one billed name I can't place. Fun if you want to gamble on a rave, otherwise skip.
description: Floored Entertainment's house and techno party, 10pm-5am at a to-be-announced Los Angeles location.

artist_notes.name: Desert Hearts
artist_notes.note: LA-born collective and label (Lee Reynolds, Mikey Lion and crew) known for sunny, bouncy house and tech-house and their festival.

artist_notes.name: Justin Martin
artist_notes.note: San Francisco producer on Dirtybird, known for bouncy, funky house and tech-house.

curator_note: Desert Hearts and Justin Martin going all night long is a proper long-form pairing, funky and bouncy rather than dark. A good Saturday for tech-house heads, and $40 is reasonable for the format.
description: Desert Hearts and Dirtybird's Justin Martin play an extended all-night set at Academy LA in Hollywood.
